comment: Shared Control/Session Core vector for the model.run.control payload digest (WS09-S7, verified by WS09-S8). Field order of the digest: org_id, user_id, space_id, space_decision_ref, recipient_audience_ref, recipient_audience_hash, privacy_policy_ref, resource_authorization_ref, run_id, operation, action_schema_hash, idempotency_key (each name NUL u64-BE-length value), then authority_revision and recipient_audience_revision (name NUL u64-BE). Header model.run.control NUL v1 NUL. Change the digest only on an intended wire change, on both sides.
